eir.0480 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0480.t
	desc = eir.0480.desc
	theme = vassal
	cooldown = { years = 12 }
	left_portrait = {
		character = scope:eir_thegn
		animation = personality_honorable
	}

	trigger = {
		eir_is_gael_ruler_trigger = yes
		is_ai = no
		eir_has_foreign_britain_counties_trigger = yes
		NOT = { has_character_flag = eir_flavor_cd }
	}

	immediate = {
		random_sub_realm_county = {
			limit = { eir_foreign_conquest_county_trigger = yes }
			save_scope_as = eir_conq_county
		}
		random_vassal = {
			save_scope_as = eir_thegn
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:eir_thegn } }
			create_character = {
				location = root.capital_province
				age = { 45 62 }
				gender_female_chance = 0
				culture = scope:eir_conq_county.culture
				faith = scope:eir_conq_county.faith
				random_traits = yes
				save_scope_as = eir_thegn
			}
		}
		add_character_flag = { flag = eir_flavor_cd years = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0480.a
		stress_impact = {
			forgiving = minor_stress_impact_loss
			vengeful = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_two_peoples_modifier years = 8 }
		add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
		scope:eir_conq_county ?= { add_county_modifier = { modifier = eir_saxon_moot_modifier years = 8 } }
		eir_resent_clear_effect = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = {
				add = 20
				has_trait = forgiving
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = just
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0480.b
		stress_impact = {
			callous = minor_stress_impact_loss
			sadistic = minor_stress_impact_loss
			compassionate = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		add_hook = { target = scope:eir_thegn type = strong_hook }
		add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
		scope:eir_conq_county ?= { change_county_control = minor_county_control_gain }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_hostage_peace_modifier years = 6 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 25
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = callous
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = paranoid
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0480.c
		stress_impact = {
			arrogant = minor_stress_impact_loss
			humble = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		add_dread = minor_dread_gain
		add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
		scope:eir_conq_county ?= { add_county_modifier = { modifier = eir_cultural_resentment_modifier years = 6 } }
		change_variable = { name = eir_resent add = 1 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 15
			modifier = {
				add = 20
				has_trait = arrogant
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				has_trait = sadistic
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0480.d
		trigger = {
			learning >= 9

eir.0486 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0486.t
	desc = eir.0486.desc
	theme = court
	cooldown = { years = 20 }
	left_portrait = {
		character = scope:eir_briton
		animation = personality_honorable
	}

	trigger = {
		eir_is_gael_ruler_trigger = yes
		is_ai = no

			is_ai = yes
			is_ruler = yes
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
			culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_brythonic }
			NOT = { this = root }
		}

		NOT = { has_character_flag = eir_flavor_cd }
	}

	immediate = {
		random_ruler = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				is_ruler = yes
				highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
				culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_brythonic }
				NOT = { this = root }
			}
			save_scope_as = eir_briton
		}
		add_character_flag = { flag = eir_flavor_cd years = 1 }

			greedy = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain

eir.0510 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0510.t
	desc = eir.0510.desc
	theme = war

	immediate = {
		random_sub_realm_county = {
			limit = { is_coastal_county = yes }
			save_scope_as = eir_conq_county
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:eir_conq_county } }
			capital_county ?= { save_scope_as = eir_conq_county }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0510.a
		stress_impact = {
			brave = minor_stress_impact_loss
			craven = minor_stress_impact_gain

			levies = 600
			men_at_arms = {
				type = light_footmen
				stacks = 2
			}
			location = scope:eir_conq_county.title_province
			origin = capital_province
			inheritable = no
			name = eir_bridgehead_host_name
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = brave
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = ambitious

		}
	}

			base = 35

				add = 15

		}
	}

		add_dread = minor_dread_gain

eir.0517 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0517.t
	desc = eir.0517.desc
	theme = diplomacy
	cooldown = { years = 20 }
	left_portrait = {
		character = scope:eir_briton
		animation = personality_honorable
	}

	trigger = {
		eir_is_gael_ruler_trigger = yes
		is_ai = no
		has_global_variable = eir_done_union
		any_ruler = {
			is_ai = yes
			is_ruler = yes
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
			culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_brythonic }
			NOT = { this = root }
		}
		NOT = { has_character_flag = eir_flavor_cd }
	}

	immediate = {
		random_ruler = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				is_ruler = yes
				highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
				culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_brythonic }
				NOT = { this = root }
			}
			save_scope_as = eir_briton
		}
		add_character_flag = { flag = eir_flavor_cd years = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0517.a
		stress_impact = {
			generous = minor_stress_impact_loss
			greedy = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_welsh_ties_modifier years = 15 }
		scope:eir_briton ?= { add_opinion = { target = root modifier = eir_fair_dealing_opinion opinion = 40 } }
		add_trait_xp = { trait = lifestyle_reveler value = 20 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 45
			modifier = {
				add = 20
				has_trait = gregarious
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				has_trait = humble
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0517.b
		stress_impact = {
			zealous = minor_stress_impact_loss
			cynical = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		add_piety = medium_piety_gain
		add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
		add_hook = { target = scope:eir_briton type = strong_hook }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_welsh_ties_modifier years = 10 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = zealous
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0517.c
		stress_impact = {
			shrewd = minor_stress_impact_loss
			trusting = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_foster_bond_modifier years = 12 }
		add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
		add_hook = { target = scope:eir_briton type = favor_hook }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 35
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = shrewd
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0517.d
		stress_impact = {
			arrogant = minor_stress_impact_loss
			humble = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain

				add = 10
				has_trait = arrogant

			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = just

		}
	}

	option = {

		}

eir.0521 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0521.t
	desc = eir.0521.desc
	theme = faith
	cooldown = { years = 20 }

	trigger = {
		eir_is_gael_ruler_trigger = yes
		is_ai = no
		eir_has_celtic_britain_counties_trigger = yes
		piety >= 60
		NOT = { has_character_flag = eir_flavor_cd }
